whatToWatch.text: Bounce-back spot at home: Seattle's 2-1 and coming off a loss, laying 7 against a Chargers team giving up 25.3 points per game — the chance to get right in front of the 12s is sitting right there.

Defense is the real deal: 16.7 points allowed per game and 2.33 sacks per game says this unit travels. Chargers are getting to the QB at the exact same clip, so whichever front wins the trenches probably wins the day — and that 42.5 total says Vegas expects a grinder.

Injury watch, honestly: nobody's officially ruled out on either side, but five Seahawks are questionable, including Julian Love and rookie lineman Grey Zabel, plus Ty Okada. L.A. has Derwin James Jr. and Keaton Mitchell on the report too. Check the inactives before kickoff — this one could hinge on who actually suits up.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle limps home from Washington carrying a rare loss, one built on a stalled running game and three turnovers that handed the Commanders 21 points — exactly the sloppiness Mike Macdonald's group has to scrub before the Chargers arrive. The secondary could get reinforcements: Julian Love, sidelined by a calf injury suffered in practice, drew a "day to day" tag from Macdonald after encouraging Monday work. How the offense reestablishes the run will shape everything else in this one.
